Forest of Deceit:
A STORM IS COMING

Forest of Deceit is a social deduction game for 4 to 8 players. You are part of a group lost in a dark, treacherous forest that seems to go on forever and ever. You can’t find any escape, and there’s a storm brewing on the horizon - a storm so massive that you all will surely perish if you can’t build a solid shelter before it arrives. Every day you explore the forest to gather resources with which to build your shelter. But the forest itself is cursed, slowly driving people into a traitorous madness; it’s surely already got a hold on some of your friends’ minds… or maybe even yours. If you don’t figure out who’s sabotaging the efforts to build a shelter, you all are going to be swept away. On the other hand, if you happen to be the Traitor and they find you, you could get kicked out of the group - for good.


A FOREST OF LIES AND BETRAYAL

From the minds of Ghost Camp and Thomas Mackinnon (creator of THE CORRIDOR and It Takes a War) comes Forest of Deceit, a back-stabbing experience about trying to survive a storm and betraying your friends. With a beautiful hand-drawn art style and a focus on casual play and social interaction, this party game is perfect for all kinds - from teenagers to grandpas, hardcore players to someone who’s never played a game in their life.

Each day, gathering parties are assigned to go deep into the forest for resources. Innocents will try to gather useful resources whereas Traitors will try to hinder the group’s advances with bad resources and try to get other players lost in the accursed woods. When the results of the day’s gathering are revealed, the group can discuss what happened - and after a few days there will even be a daily vote to expel suspected Traitors from the group. If the Innocents can build the shelter in time, they win! If not… it’s a victory for treachery.

Focusing on casual play and social interaction, Forest of Deceit is fun for all kinds of players - from a family experience to group meetings; from non-gamers to hardcore players!


FEATURES

- Gather resources to build a shelter against the upcoming storm. If you are a Traitor, you will try to get other people lost in the forest, and hinder the group’s efforts by collecting bad resources. 

- Discuss what happened, and eventually start voting suspect Traitors out. If the Traitors can prevent the Innocents building a shelter in time, they win.

- Create your own house rules: An endlessly replayable party game, with fully customisable game options. 

- Use your own phones, tablets, or computers for each player to play right from their very own web browser.

- Fantastic for both local multiplayer and online play. Works great with screen-sharing for online play!

NOTE: No generative AI was used in the making of this game or its associated assets.

Chico's Delivery:
Get ready for a delicious, fun, and fast-thinking adventure in a world where every delivery needs to be perfect. In Chico’s Delivery, you control an adorable pizza-delivery bird that slides endlessly across the environment, turning every stage into a clever and irresistibly addictive puzzle.
\n
\nBut reaching the destination is only part of the challenge. Every table has a counter that decreases with each movement you make, creating a strategic race against time and against your own mistakes. Carefully plan your route, choose the perfect path, and figure out how to serve every table before the orders expire.
\n
\nThe biggest twist comes from the way Chico moves. Once he starts sliding, he only stops when he collides with a wall, obstacle, or environmental object. This turns every movement into an important decision where predicting trajectories and thinking several steps ahead becomes essential for success.
\n
\nAs the journey continues, new mechanics make the puzzles even more creative. Use pizza teleporters, deal with rising tables, take advantage of directional arrows, and learn how to manipulate the environment to create perfect deliveries. Every level introduces a fresh situation that demands observation, logic, and strategy.
\n
\nWith cute visuals, a cozy atmosphere, and clever challenges, Chico’s Delivery offers the kind of relaxing and satisfying experience that makes you want to play “just one more level.” It is the perfect balance between accessible puzzles and increasingly strategic decisions.
\n
\nPerfect for fans of logic games, casual challenges, and adventures full of personality, Chico’s Delivery transforms simple pizza deliveries into a fun, charming, and surprisingly strategic journey.
\n
\nObserve the stage, slide through the perfect route, and make sure no pizza arrives late.

CleanSheet Football 2:
From the creators of CleanSheet Football, CleanSheet 2 delivers the definitive goalkeeping experience on PlayStation®VR2. Step between the posts with faster gameplay, advanced training systems, and authentic match situations designed to test your reactions, positioning, and composure under pressure.

MATCH PLAY
Face realistic, motion-captured match situations inspired by professional football — from in-swinging corners and curling free kicks to dangerous 2-on-1 breakaways and high-pressure penalties. Every save feels intense, physical, and rewarding as you react in real time to match-winning moments.

DRILLS
Sharpen your reflexes, handling, and decision-making across a variety of high-intensity goalkeeper drills and training modes. Stop rapid-fire deflections in Matrix Reflex, improve hand speed in Lightning Hands, and push your reactions to the limit with challenges designed to develop real goalkeeping skills.

SHOT CREATOR

Cornfield:
When the walls themselves seem to be alive, there is nowhere to hide. In Cornfield, you find yourself in the middle of a massive, suffocating maze of towering stalks. It is pitch black at night, the dirt paths twist into endless dead ends, and the only warning that you are being hunted is the chilling sound of rustling leaves. A relentless, terrifying monster tracks your every move through the shadows. This is not a combat game; it is a desperate test of navigation and survival.

Finding the exit is only half the battle. A series of complex puzzles and environmental challenges block your path to freedom and demand your full concentration. You must decipher clues and unlock new areas of the maze quickly yet carefully. The true terror of Cornfield lies in striking the right balance between logic and panic. Every second you spend standing still to crack a code gives the beast another second to close the distance.

Test your strategy and nerves in this heart-pounding escape adventure, where one wrong turn could be your last. Keep moving and think fast under pressure to conquer the maze before the terrifying creature catches up to you. 

Will you outsmart the nightmare lurking in the fields, or will you be consumed by the harvest?

Is Today Another Day?:
You wake up in your apartment, surrounded by the stark, minimalist geometry of a black-and-white world. Your everyday tasks, such as making the bed, washing the dishes, and taking out the trash, appear ordinary. However, in this bizarre setting, completing these everyday chores is the key to accessing the outside world.

It's a unique first-person escape room experience that mixes everyday chores with mind-bending puzzles. As you navigate the quiet rooms of your home, observe your surroundings carefully. Trust your instincts as you collect useful objects, decipher cryptic symbols painted on the walls, and manipulate strange mechanisms hidden among your furniture. The answers to your escape are buried in the television static and the wall gears.

The striking low-poly art style, paired with subtle chromatic glitch effects and a haunting sense of isolation, transforms an ordinary apartment into an intriguing puzzle box. Complete your tasks, unlock the secrets of your home, and escape the monotony of everyday life to earn your freedom.
Mechaconda:
Take control of the Mechaconda and face Dr. EVIL's robotic army in this ultimate arcade action experience for PlayStation.

Pit Panic:

\n
\nTake on the role of a curious archeologist and race through handcrafted levels, take down ancient bosses and jump up like your pants are on fire.
\n
\nGET HOOKED!

\nTHINK FAST, RUN FASTER

\nCHALLENGE OTHER PLAYERS

Project SNAQE is an action and precision game inspired by the classic Snake, where the goal is to expand the cargo in your wagons as much as possible by collecting minerals scattered across the land.

Don’t be surprised when you encounter explosive rocks or giant worms and moles—use your ability to shoot projectiles and perform precise maneuvers to overcome the various obstacles that appear throughout the game.

The game features 3 different modes with progressively increasing difficulty levels, as well as a classic mode that brings back the traditional Snake gameplay.

Project SNAQE promises a great experience for all types of players, from casual to hardcore, also offering various achievements and a global leaderboard.

Plungeez:
Get ready for an introspective and challenging journey beneath the surface. Plungeez combines the classic exploration structure of a Metroidvania with the analytical depth of a pure puzzle game. Here, the environment is both your greatest adversary and your greatest reward.  Unlike linear adventures, Plungeez requires you to observe, plan, and revisit familiar areas with fresh eyes. 
\n
\nEach mechanic you discover is a key to a new section of the map, transforming exploration into a constant stream of “eureka” moments. If you’re looking for an experience that respects your intelligence and rewards thorough curiosity, you’ve found your next destination.  
\n
\nDive deep into this adventure set in the underground of the historic Brazilian city of Salvador, Bahia.
Cash Movers:
Cash Movers is a 2D cooperative puzzle-platformer about two unlikely partners trying to escape a heavily guarded prison while collecting as much cash as possible along the way.
Players control two different burglars, each with their own role, size, and strengths. The smaller character is fast, agile, and perfect for reaching tight spaces, climbing, activating switches, and sneaking through dangerous areas. The larger character is slower but stronger, able to push heavy crates, carry objects, throw items, and help solve puzzles that the smaller character cannot complete alone.

Every level is built around cooperation, timing, and clever use of the environment. Players must move through prison corridors, security rooms, industrial platforms, locked passages, traps, lasers, moving platforms, pressure buttons, sliding doors, safes, cameras, guards, and other hazards. Progress often requires using both characters together: one may need to stand on a button while the other passes through a door, push a crate into position, avoid a patrol, disable a mechanism, or create a path forward.

Expect short but carefully designed levels with increasing complexity. Early stages introduce basic movement, buttons, doors, crates, and simple platforming. Later levels add more advanced mechanics such as moving platforms, animated traps, security cameras, laser barriers, locked safes, enemy guards, timing-based obstacles, and multi-step puzzles where both characters must work together.

Key features:
•  Cooperative puzzle-platform gameplay
•  Two playable characters with different abilities
•  Levels built around teamwork and timing
•  Pushable crates, pressure buttons, sliding doors, traps, lasers, cameras, safes, and guards
•  Levels that become more complex as new mechanics are introduced
•  Designed for quick, satisfying puzzle-solving sessions
Pyramid Quest Junior:

D-topia:
Step into a future where happiness is curated by artificial intelligence, in this gentle-paced puzzle adventure.

The Utopia Project was created in the interest of maximizing human happiness and comfort. As the newest residential Facilitator at D-topia, your role is to resolve issues around the residential community. Momento:

Scholar Adventure: Mystery of Silence:

Shujinkou Manga Reader:
A new way to experience the world of Shujinkou begins here.

Shujinkou Manga Reader is a free manga app that brings the critically acclaimed JRPG Shujinkou to life through original manga stories, character moments, music, and future reading-focused features.

Set in a world divided into six distinct nations, Shujinkou follows Shu, Jin, Kou, and their companions as they face intelligent, language-devouring Akuma (demons) and the dangers hidden throughout each land. The first release introduces the Genya and Sabaku Arcs, the first two nations in this world.

This app includes a One Shot manga that explores a mission connected to the events of the game and what happens after the battle. Shu, Jin, Kou, Shirouto, and Toushirou investigate the ruined temple Moku Jinja after reports of gruesome murders, taking them through labyrinth exploration, fierce combat, Kanakae Orbs, and more. The second half of the One Shot showcases the daily lives, humor, friendships, and wider cast of Shujinkou through a fun beach party filled with sushi, swimsuits, and more.

Created with support from a game planner who worked on Persona 5, this manga project was developed to introduce Shujinkou's world, characters, and story-driven RPG experience in a more approachable, story-first format.

Shujinkou Manga Reader is completely free at launch, with more manga stories and chapters planned throughout the year. Major educational-oriented features are also being planned for the future.

KEY FEATURES
・Read an original Shujinkou One Shot manga for free.
・Experience a story set in Genya, the first nation of Shujinkou.
・Follow Shu, Jin, Kou, Shirouto, Toushirou, and others through battle, danger, and comedy.
・Explore a manga story featuring labyrinth exploration, the Akuma, a boss fight, and everyday life in the world of Shujinkou.
・Toggle Japanese Mode to read the manga in Japanese (with Furigana support included) while keeping the app UI in its original language.
・Play selected music tracks from Shujinkou while reading and adjust the mood of each scene.
・Look forward to more manga stories, chapters, and learning-oriented features planned for the future.

This application is designed as an approachable entry point into the Shujinkou IP. Whether you already played the JRPG or are discovering this world for the first time, enjoy this free, story-first way to meet its characters, explore its atmosphere, and experience the heart of Shujinkou through manga!

Follow this app and official Shujinkou channels to see what comes next.

CULTIC:

Crawl from your grave and fight your way through the ranks of a twisted cult with an arsenal of realistic weapons and an original soundtrack that puts you right in the heart of the horror. CULTIC mixes lethal combat with immersive, survival horror to create a violently satisfying experience. Includes the original campaign, Interlude, the Chapter Two expansion campaign, all Survival maps, and the Cultmas bonus map. 

Made in the style of a classic shooter, but with a modern feel, CULTIC gives you the freedom to approach combat your way. You can run in guns blazing as you jump, slide, and dodge to keep out of harm's way. If you prefer a slower approach, you can lay traps, let enemies come to you, and pick them off from the safety of cover. Armed with a variety of mid-century firearms and explosives, you'll be well equipped to slaughter everything in your path, provided you don't get slaughtered first.

Chapter One is set in rural, 1960s America, where you explore cult outposts, dusty catacombs, abandoned asylums, and much more. Chapter Two brings you into ravaged streets of New Grandewel, where corpses litter the roads and cultists infest every inch of the city you once protected. The thrilling second campaign includes new weapons and enemies, a new soundtrack, and even more brutality.

CULTIC was styled to feel like a throwback to the shooters of yore, but with more realistic physics, a deeply explorable environment, and a fully 3D game world. The gameplay, audio design, and art are all stylized to create a one-of-a-kind, living nightmare.

FEATURES

- A unique blend of a retro-style, boomer shooter with elements of immersive, survival horror. 
- Brutal and creative combat! The game rewards multiple play styles, ranging from slow and strategic to bunny-hopping run-and-gun.
- A full arsenal of mid-century firearms and explosives.

Seishin:
What started as a late-night dare has turned into a desperate fight for survival. You are trapped in an abandoned school with a demonic entity that has possessed your best friend. Armed with only a flashlight, you must navigate the eerie, pitch-black hallways and classrooms to find a way out. You cannot fight back against the spirit. Your only options are to run, use stealth to stay out of sight, and listen closely for the terrifying sound of her approaching footsteps.

Your survival depends on navigating a dynamic, escalating threat system. The entity knows you are trying to leave. The closer you get to escaping, the more aggressive and enraged she becomes. The hunt intensifies, her patrols tighten, and the pressure mounts. You must time your movements perfectly to slip past her while searching for the exit.

As the spirit's anger reaches its peak, the horror spills over into reality. The environment warps, blood fills your vision, and sinister glitches attempt to trick your mind and break your focus. Maintain your composure, manage your limited visibility, and outsmart the deadly entity hunting you in the darkness. Will you survive the night, or will the school claim another victim?

San Francisco, 1915. Our story begins as a young boy sneaks aboard a mysterious ship in the dead of night. His name? Makoto Daito. Born to an American father and a Japanese mother, Makoto's world is one of harsh persecution, a fate cruely cast upon him simply because of his Asian heritage. After losing both of his parents and finding himself completely alone, Makoto, in an act of desperation, decides to risk it all and travel to his mother's birthplace. With nothing but the shirt on his back, Makoto soon learns, however, that his voyage across the Pacific is anything but a "free ride," and that this one choice will forever change the course of his life. ■5 ERAS, 5 CITIES The story unfolds across a version of Japan that may have existed in another life altogether, immersing you in 5 sprawling cities, each modeled after real locations of their respective eras. 1915, Kokura, Fukuoka: home of what was said to be one of the world’s largest foundries, a smoke-scorched town bursting with the passion of hard-driven, equally fiery workers. 1929, Kure, Hiroshima: a port town dominated by Japan’s largest naval arsenal and heavily influenced by the presence of yakuza organizations. 1943, Minami, Osaka: the biggest entertainment district in western Japan, set against the ever-rising tension of a world at war. 1951, Atami, Shizuoka: a bustling seaside getaway synonymous with tourism in postwar Japan. 1965, Shinjuku, Tokyo: Japan’s most iconic pleasure district—a city of swirling and unpredictable chaos. ■THE MOST CREATIVE, INTUITIVE, AND EXTREME VIOLENCE In these turbulent times, fighting to survive means one thing: doing whatever it takes. Additionally, you’ll master and enhance a wide array of weapons—knives, hammers, katanas, and more—as you fight your way through era after violent era. ■LIFE OF A SHOWMAN In the earliest chapters of our story, Makoto's guide and mentor discovers his hidden talent for music, and, before long, Makoto finds himself not only singing a tune or two but stepping into the role of a showman, producing a wide variety of incredible acts throughout all of Japan. In order to get these shows off the ground, Makoto must gather rumors from the streets and use them to scout skilled singers and performers. He can then head out into town to create new music—collecting any and every sound he can find: the swish of a broom, snoring of a sleepy neighbor, the rumble of passing trains, distant animal cries, even the grunts and growls of the enemies he fights. By combining these sounds, Makoto can craft original tracks, brand new music for the whole nation to hear. From there, he'll choose the setlist, arrange the band, assign a cast, and design the production—from lighting colors to staging—all in an effort to bring each show to life. The iconic game The 7th Guest has been brought back to life with modern technology, delivering an atmospheric story like no other.
\n
\nSix guests have been welcomed to a foreboding mansion, but something sinister is at play. The wealthy recluse and toymaker Henry Stauf lurks in the shadows, and a dark power hangs over the house, shrouded in mystery. Who is the seventh guest? What does Henry want with them? And who will live to tell the tale?
\n
\nAs you explore the eerie mansion, the puzzles grow increasingly challenging, with dangers lurking around every corner. Every shadow, distant creak, and flicker of light builds tension as the house slowly reveals its secrets.
\n
\nThe 7th Guest is the ultimate mystery adventure for players who love mind-bending puzzles, haunting exploration, and a chilling story.
\n
\n- Cinematic Storytelling Through Volumetric Video: Step inside the story. Using cutting-edge, newly recorded volumetric video, live-action performances are captured in full 3D, placing you directly inside Henry Stauf’s mansion at the heart of the mystery. Real actors appear within the world itself, making every encounter feel immediate and unsettling.
\n- Unique Mind-Bending Puzzle Gameplay: The equally beloved and feared haunted mansion comes alive around you with high-end visuals and carefully redesigned, all-new handcrafted puzzles. Every puzzle is woven into the story and rooted in the mansion’s lore, with recognizable elements that pay homage to the original.
\n- Dynamic Environments: The haunted mansion shifts and transforms around you through high-end visuals and clever optical illusions. Investigate every creepy nook and cranny. Unlock new rooms, uncover hidden secrets, and keep your wits about you as the horrors within begin to close in.

Two Types Pollos: In Two Types Pollos, managing your business is a matter of life or death. During the day, you must run your chicken shop: serve customers, prepare the best dishes, and keep the place spotless. But behind the counter lies a harsher reality: you manufacture "sugar" not out of ambition, but out of necessity. Your body depends on an exclusive medicine that you can only get by fulfilling sugar orders. If you don't deliver the orders on time, there will be no dose, and if there is no dose, it’s game over. It’s a constant balance between keeping the shop perfect and ensuring your survival for one more day. Face this challenge alone, coordinating every minute so the grills stay hot and the sugar shipments never stop. Manage your chicken shop with flawless service: cook, serve, and organize orders so customers are satisfied and money flows. Buy furniture, decorate, and renovate the establishment to make it the coziest spot in the neighborhood. Go out to buy ingredients and supplies so the kitchen and workshop never run out of stock. In the vital manufacturing side, produce "sugar" in your private area to meet the demands of your medicine suppliers. It is a race against time: if you fail a delivery, you won't receive the medicine that keeps you alive. Every day is an extension. Decide whether to spend your profits on improving the shop or optimizing production to ensure your health.

Steamboat Incident:
This product entitles you to download both the digital PS4® version and the digital PS5® version of this game.

Steamboat Incident is a 3D survival horror experience set aboard a steamboat lost in the middle of the open sea. You have been kidnapped by the crazy monster. It is said that the monster went crazy after being locked up and away for over 95 years.
Captured and trapped with no clear way out, you wake up and must explore the ship’s tight corridors and rusting decks in search of clues, tools, and a way to escape.
But you are not alone. The monster is still there, reacting to sound and movement. Every step, every creak of the floorboards could give you away.
Hide, stay quiet, and think carefully as you solve puzzles and fix the steamboat in order to escape.

Features:
* A terrifying journey across the open ocean, stranded on a decaying steamboat while something hunts you from the depths. 
* Explore tight passageways and claustrophobic corridors as you uncover the steamboat dark secrets. 
* Search the steamboat for parts needed to fix the wheel and escape.
* Scavenge for clues, supplies, and hiding spots to stay one step ahead of the creature trying to hunt you down. 
* Find items like canned food to recover, and broken wheel parts to bring the steamboat back to life. 
* Evade a horrifying barnacle-covered entity stalking the ship - run, hide, and survive. Take cover under tables or inside rooms to avoid detection. 
* Use tools like crowbars to break into locked areas and reveal hidden paths and deeper mysteries.

Which Is It?:
If you are fantastic at recognising images or have good general knowledge then this is the game for you. Which Is It? is a simple, addictive quiz game where you simply have to name what you see in the photographic images. Images are split into categories and you start with five categories unlocked. Get images correct from multiple choice answers to earn points and use those points to unlock new categories – in all there are fifty categories and each has ten images to identify. The images get progressively more difficult as the round goes on. You can choose the order you unlock rounds so pick your favourite categories! For an extra challenge, play with the timer activated

Features:
500 images to identify
If you prefer a relaxing game, the timer can be turned off
Simple user interface and controls
Good quality music

Zumba - Jurassic Marble Quest:
Zumba – Jurassic Marble Quest blasts you back to the age of dinosaurs! Play as an adventurous baby dino equipped with a marble-firing snout. Select your stage, aim down a winding stone path, and launch colorful marbles to create chains of three or more before they tumble off the cliff. Trigger spectacular combos, clear each wave swiftly, and claim up to three stars by keeping the marbles at bay. 
\nBetween levels, call upon prehistoric power-ups: Explosive Marbles to blow away clusters, Time Freeze to halt advancing marbles, Repaint to change your next marble’s hue, Slow Motion to decelerate the line, Destruction Shots to remove a single stray marble, and Time Revert to undo a misfire for a second chance. 
\nEvery ten levels, you stomp into a new Jurassic realm—lush Fern Forest Valleys, sizzling Volcanic Badlands, misty Swamp Marshes, and glittering Crystal Caves—each introducing fresh marble colors, winding paths, moving obstacles, and ever-increasing speeds. 
\nAddictive and family-friendly, Zumba – Jurassic Marble Quest combines classic marble-shooter thrills with adorable dinos and prehistoric charm.

A collection of 10 games by Thom Hopper, a pioneer developer for the "PlayStation Mobile" platform, brings together unique titles that capture the essence of independent games. From wave-based shooters and procedural space quests, the TACS Classic Collection lets players relive a unique slice of gaming history. 
This collection is a piece of PlayStation legacy, offering players the chance to experience previously lost media. Loaded with quirky characters, strange worlds, and arcade-style challenges, each game in the TACS Classic Collection allows players to jump into fun and unique games. Key Features:
10 Unique Games — Includes Out of Mind, Radiant Flux, Super Brain Eat 3, Shuttle Quest 2000, Sea Run, Super Skull Smash GO!, Super Tank Poker, Console Saga, Meltdown Moon, and King Bean. Each game brings a distinct visual and gameplay style.
Preservation — Play games that were once exclusive to a now-lost platform, fully revived for modern systems.
Nostalgic and Experimental — Explore a variety of retro-inspired games that pay homage to the creative limitations and spirit of early gaming.

Escape from Umbra:
Umbra is hunting you. She has eyes lurking everywhere within the shadows, and she will not stop until she finds you and locks your soul away forever.
\n
\nTrapped in a mysterious village ruled by darkness, your only tools to escape her curse are a small flashlight and a secret book of clues. Move unseen, follow the cats' hints, and solve the enigmas to find your path to freedom.
\n
\n•	The Secret Book: An enigmatic journal filled with information and clues that will help you solve the various puzzles and riddles you must face to escape.
\n
\n•	Exploration & Interaction: Investigate your surroundings, pick up items, examine them, and combine them. Discover how to use and manipulate the environment to escape from each area.
\n
\n•	The Flashlight: More than just lighting your way in a world of near-total darkness, it serves as a crucial tool with a powerful flash function. But use it wisely and keep a close eye on your battery.
\n
\n•	The Cats: When you see them, trust them. They will guide you and help you through key moments of your adventure.
\n
\n•	A Village in Darkness: Inspired by mountain witch legends, this labyrinthine village is open for exploration, yet remains a world drenched in shadows and darkness.
\n
\n•	The Witch: She roams the streets of the village, relentlessly hunting you. If you hear roots creaking, turn off your flashlight and hide quickly where she cannot see you.
\n
\n•	The Specters: Summoned by the witch to watch every corner, they are alert to any trace of light. Avoid being seen, as they are fast and precise. But if they find you, your flashlight's flash function will give you a chance to shake them off.
\n
\n•	Traces of Black Magic & Mirrors: Clouds of shadows and mirrors frozen in time. Find a way to discover what they hide.
\n
\n•	Vibration Mechanics: Feel your heartbeat—light when you seem safe, but intense and rapid when danger is near.
\n
\n•	Adaptive Triggers: Immerse yourself in the experience by using the adaptive triggers on your controller to operate the flashlight’s functions as if it were real.
\n
\nDo you dare to face your fears and unveil the secrets of Umbra’s domain?

Death Run:
In the future, entertainment is everything — and nothing pulls ratings like watching contestants die. 
\n
\nDeath Run drops you into the world's most dangerous live broadcast: a high-stakes sci-fi game show where participants are thrown into merciless laser gauntlets and the only exit is the finish line. Watched by billions, judged by the millisecond, you are the latest contestant. The question isn't whether the show wants you dead — it does. The question is whether you're fast enough, sharp enough, and precise enough to make it out anyway. 
\n
\nAt its core, Death Run is a 3D precision platformer built around fluid movement and split-second decision making. Courses are laced with moving lasers — rotating, sweeping, pulsing, and converging in patterns that demand full attention and quick adaptation. A single hit sends you back to the start. There are no checkpoints. There is only the run. 
\n
\nYour movement arsenal gives you the tools to survive: jump, double jump, upward dash, forward dash, float, and a momentum system that rewards players who keep moving forward without hesitation. Combining these fluidly is the difference between a clean run and a reset. 
\n
\nThe game is built in levels, each taking one to two minutes to complete. Every five levels the action pauses for a story segment — expanding the dark, Squid Game-inspired narrative of the show, its hosts, its rules, and the world watching from the outside. The further you progress, the more the story peels back the layers of what this broadcast really is. 
\n
\nWith a sleek neon-lit visual style, pounding atmosphere, and courses that escalate in complexity and speed, Death Run is a game about mastery. Each failed run teaches you something. Each completed run is earned.

The Caribou Trail:
Gallipoli, 1915.

Far from home, Fisher leaves his quiet harbor town in Newfoundland to join the British war effort with his friends. They expect a short-lived adventure full of tales to bring back home.

What awaits them is not glory, but dirt, loss… and a touch of madness. The quiet gestures that hold a regiment together, the impossible choices, the weight of survival and... well, dubious stews no one back home would dare to call edible.


A GRIPPING STORY : INSPIRED BY REAL EVENTS

The Caribou Trail is a visceral, first-person narrative experience about a band of friends sent on some of the most unlikely missions of the Great War.

Inspired by real testimonies, The Caribou Trail blends history with fiction to portray a rarely explored front of WWI: Gallipoli, from the landing to the final evacuation.

Cut through barbed wire in no man’s land on a desperate reconnaissance mission, silence a sniper holding the line, and make noise during a chaotic evacuation. Each step is experienced through your own eyes.

Yet this is not about winning the war, it’s about enduring it. Explore the back lines, feel the weight of anticipation, stumble through the trenches, reclaim the dog tags of fallen comrades, and share stories with those who still have the strength to speak. Sit by the fire, share ghostly tales (that may or may not be true), and find warmth around the campfire.

When the time comes, you may choose to pull the trigger… or not. Every gesture brings you closer to the men who laugh beside you… and fall before you.

There is no score. No kill count. Only resilience, fleeting friendship, and the fragile hope of making it home.


FRIENDSHIP FORGED IN DIRT

War may take everything, but it also builds bonds.

You and your companions are not hardened soldiers, but ordinary men: fishermen, dreamers, storytellers; cooking fish’n’brews in battered pots, laughing at bad jokes, and clinging to one another when silence grows too heavy.

In the chaos, these small rituals become lifelines - reminders of who you are, and of who's fighting alongside you. What begins as survival becomes brotherhood, etched into memory long after the guns fall silent.

Gordon - Insufferable and lovable. Always the center of attention. He'll crack a joke or roast you at the worst moment possible, but he'll be there for you no matter what.

Lonnie - A whimsical, dreamy kid who doesn't belong, but still strives to do his best. What he lacks in military prowess, he compensates with his warmth and spirit. He'll even share a good spooky story or two to change the mood…

Fisher - You are the middle brother, constantly defusing (or participating in) Gordo and Lon's bickering. In the face of the war's horrors, you define Fisher's willingness to see things as they are, or instead delve into superstitious escapism.

These are the faces you will remember long after Gallipoli.


FOLKLORE AND GHOST STORIES

When night falls, the line between reality and imagination blurs.

Are the shadows in the trenches just tricks of the firelight, or spirits drawn to the living? In The Caribou Trail, folklore and psychological horror intertwine, echoing how soldiers made sense of a world that no longer did.

What you find may not change history, but it might change you.


FEATURES

- Visceral First-Person Experience
- Narrative Exploration
- Friendship & Humor
- Folklore & Psychological Horror
- Inspired by Real Events
- Original Score & Immersive Sound Design
- Stylized Visuals

Race along courses with various landscapes and buildings from all over the world while avoiding obstacles like drums and oil as you aim for the goal across all 6 stages.
Slam into enemy cars to make them crash! Or jump into the air and land on them to crush them down! In this survival race, anything goes!

Kynseed:
Embark on a lifetime of adventure in a beautiful world of creativity and intrigue. Raise a family, customise your farm, run a business, craft items, and battle some marvellously malevolent monsters.

Your actions and decisions matter in our adventurous story filled with purpose and promise. Lend a helping hand to villagers in need and discover the unique blend of creativity and choice that sets Kynseed apart. Come and join us - your legacy awaits!

• Story-driven RPG set in beautiful regions, where you’ll battle dark faery tale creatures.
• Customise your farm and farmhouse using Kynseed's customisation mode with hundreds of items and limitless design possibilities.
• Take on the role of shopkeeper and run your own blacksmith, potion shop, tavern, or bustling goods store.
• Develop relationships with villagers who will remember your deeds, actions, and pranks!
• Combat the evil Hob army as they construct powerful totems and cause the destruction of crops and buildings.
• Rebuild broken houses and buildings for your neighbours and new NPCs.
• Gather materials to create items, forge weapons or mix cures for bizarre maladies.
• Buy strange artifacts from the mysterious Mr Fairweather — items that ease your chores, boost your combat skills, or simply let you bend the rules of the world. But beware his life tax: each one costs years from your life.
• A world where everyone ages -  raise a family then step into your children's shoes and continue your legacy.
Call of Duty®: Black Ops:
Experience the original Call of Duty®: Black Ops, first released in 2010, now available on PS4™ and PS5® for the first time.

Call of Duty®: Black Ops will take you behind enemy lines as a member of an elite special forces unit engaging in covert warfare, classified operations and explosive conflicts across the globe. With access to exclusive weaponry and equipment, your actions will tip the balance during the most dangerous time period mankind has ever known.

Call of Duty®: Black Ops features a cinematic single-player campaign, signature Multiplayer and hordes of the undead in Zombies.
Call of Duty®: Black Ops II:
Experience the original Call of Duty®: Black Ops II, first released in 2012, now available on PS4™ and PS5® for the first time.
\n
\nCall of Duty®: Black Ops II propels players into a near future, 21st Century Cold War, where technology and weapons have converged to create a new generation of warfare.
Solitaire Legends – Sakura Dreams:
Solitaire Legends – Sakura Dreams combines timeless Solitaire gameplay with a peaceful anime presentation filled with soft colors and elegant designs.
\n
\nPlay classic Klondike Solitaire in 1-card or 3-card draw mode, focusing on clean moves, smart decisions, and a satisfying flow. Each completed game rewards you with score and experience, based on how efficiently you play.
\n
\nAs you gain experience, you level up and unlock cosmetic rewards. These include beautiful anime-style card skins, serene backgrounds inspired by cherry blossoms and temples, and stylish card backs. Every single card has multiple skins and can be customized individually.
\n
\nBefore each match, you can freely adjust your deck and table to match your mood. Whether you prefer soft pastel tones, detailed anime illustrations, or a more minimal look, every game feels personal and relaxing.
\n
\nWith no time pressure and a steady sense of progression, Sakura Dreams offers hours of soothing gameplay and a constantly growing collection of beautiful cards.
The Sinking City 2:
A survival horror in Lovecraft’s world
The Sinking City 2 is a third-person survival horror set in 1920s Arkham. Deliberate, tense, and resource-lean: pressure builds as you push deeper, relief comes in brief refuge, and fear is something you manage. Mind your inventory, take on unnerving puzzles, and double back via unlocked shortcuts for supplies and upgrades.

Arkham, New England
A Roaring ’20s port city buckling under a supernatural flood. Tide-stained avenues and battered Art Deco. Speakeasies gone dark. Districts feel lived-in and water-worn, with routes by foot and skiff, shortcuts behind collapsed seawalls, and secrets tucked in boarded parlors. You’ll navigate a hospital where science hides its face, a fish market where the merchandise bites back, and descend deep below the city to where eldritch horrors stir.

A rescue with impossible stakes
A ritual gone wrong trapped her soul in the Dreamlands, and now malevolent forces have stolen her body. To rescue the woman you love, you must walk a dangerous path through catastrophe to the source of the flood, her presence always felt but rarely seen.

Fearsome foes
The Slither animate the dead. Deep Ones surge from dark water. Shadows bend space and test nerves. Some fights must be met head-on; others may require a retreat, rearm, and retune of your build in a place of refuge. Or maybe you take on an optional investigation, and return with an upgraded gun.

Investigate at will
Exploration is the key to survival. Read ritual residues, sift through grisly clues, decode journals that shouldn’t exist, and pry at masks that won’t come off. Optional cases never gate progress, but they unlock safer routes, valuable supplies, and upgrades that increase your odds of surviving the next encounter.

Built with uncommon devotion
The Sinking City 2 draws on Frogwares’ detective roots to deliver survival horror that runs deep and hits hard. Shaped by studio obsession and community feedback, it’s a faithful Lovecraft experience: myths made manifest, and the inconceivable fear that results.
Once Human: Once Human is a Strange Worlds Survival Game set in a bizarre, apocalyptic world. Fight side by side with friends for survival resources, build your home territory, and overcome the terrifying unknown together as you uncover the truth behind the fall of the world. You were once human. Do you still hold the answer to what it means to be human?
Viking Frontiers:
Survival of your people - that's the only thing that matters. Become the leader of a newly founded Viking settlement and lead it to safety and glory. Gather, build, craft, hunt, raid and follow your Gods to endure hardships of nature and save your clan from violent destruction.

Welcome to the North
A series of unfortunate events has brought you to an unknown shore, and it is your task to transform it into your new home and fortress.

Can you unite the remnants of your clan? Can you withstand the challenges of nature? And most importantly, will you prove worthy of the honorable title of Jarl? The fate of your people rests on your shoulders…

Viking Frontiers Features
- A deep, extensive survival system
- Immersive simulation features, including crafting, building, hunting, expeditions and many, many more
- Management of clansmen’s needs, laws, activities and living conditions
- Beautiful, realistic graphics that allow you to experience everything from a first-person perspective
- Numerous quests, random events, day and night system
- Addictive gameplay steeped in an authentic Viking vibe and awesome sound effects


Your people need you
Know that your newly formed settlement will face many challenges and difficulties. You, as its leader, must learn to recognize the most favorable opportunities and the greatest threats. It's entirely up to you, whether you choose to follow the path of the hunter, farmer, priest, builder, or any mixture of them all. Discover your own ways of survival and master a host of useful skills to tame this wild, dangerous land.

Feel the thrill of survival
Viking Frontiers combines the best elements of RPG, Survival, Simulation, and Strategy genres to provide you with an absolutely unique gaming experience. If you choose so, you can delve into the main story, explore the in-game world, or focus on side quests or your other favorite activities.

Jump right into the misty tale straight from the Viking sagas and enjoy varied, highly replayable gameplay.
Welcome to Kowloon: Search for cheap housing in Kowloon and step into a first-person indie horror experience where ordinary people hide unsettling faces. What begins as a simple visit to a new home becomes a descent into narrow streets, cramped rooms, and secrets guarded from outsiders.\n\nExplore a frightening place filled with strange personalities, follow clues through misty alleys and concrete corridors, and feel the tension build through atmospheric visuals and high-quality 3D sound. Welcome to Kowloon is a short, story-focused horror journey in the walking simulator genre.
Lamp Clicker:
Lamp Clicker is a simple and addictive incremental / idle clicker game where your goal is to build your own… lamp empire.

You click the lamp.
The lamp starts to glow.
Your earnings increase.
You feel satisfaction.

You unlock new lamps — from ordinary candles and oil lamps… to increasingly bizarre creations you’d rather not question (yes, we’re looking at you, Toilet Lamp).

You start to wonder… does this make any sense?
You keep clicking…
Rebooted Fate:
Amid the financial crisis, recent graduate Qi Nian's life plunged into a sudden abyss. Stepping out of campus brimming with aspirations, he found himself besieged by unemployment, confusion, and loneliness, nearly crushed under the weight of reality.
In this desperate situation, he unexpectedly activated a reversal system, marking a turning point in his life. Accompanied by his roommate Zhao Tingting, he encounters women like model Lin Meina, celebrity Wu Jiayun, intellectual Yu Xinmei, and flight attendant Feng Yalin, navigating life's crossroads through repeated fateful choices.
Whether to draw near or drift apart, chase dreams or settle for stability, compromise or resist—each decision reshapes bonds and rewrites destinies. Emotions deepen through friction, souls mature through trials, and the dual-system conflict fills his path with uncertainty and tension.
To protect the one he cherishes, Qi Nian resolutely embarks on a passionate journey. He pierces through fate's fog, reversing his downfall through deliberate choices. In an era of uncertainty, he writes his own legend of triumph.
New York Mysteries 1: Secrets of the Maf: New York, 1955. It's become dangerous in the city. The mafia is trying to seize power. But recently, a new force appeared. A far more terrible force. Over the last few days, five mafia bosses have disappeared in mysterious circumstances. A strange liquid and a butterfly were found at the scenes of the disappearances. But this isn't what scared the citizens... Children started to disappear in the city. All of them drew exactly the same butterflies before they disappeared. This forced detectives and journalists alike to start their investigations.
High Cars 3: Race higher, faster, and through more daring paths than ever before in the next evolution of the series. Experience high-speed racing and precision platforming with improved graphics, richer lighting, with curved and winding tracks that bring every course to life in a fresh, dynamic way. Speed across towering metal frameworks and futuristic structures suspended high above the world, navigating slopes, spirals, bends, and sudden drops that demand both control and courage. Unlock new vehicles, race against the clock, and push for the perfect run across a set of challenging courses that grow increasingly complex.
Taishogun: The Rise of Emperor:
During the 12th-century Heian-Jidai period, internal tensions rose as the power of the clans grew alongside the imperial court, and mysterious supernatural phenomena began to occur.

Over the years, two powerful clans engaged in intense conflicts for dominance. One of these clans, led by the legendary Shogun Hōjō Tokimasa, achieved significant victories against their enemies.

However, regional leaders retained considerable power and influence. They secretly allied with occult forces to defeat and assassinate the legendary Shogun, aiming to seize his position as military chief.

After his assassination, all military power was transferred to his daughter, Hōjō Masako.

Thus began the Genpei War, with Masako on a mission to defeat all enemy demons and clans conspiring to avenge the legendary Tokimasa.
Foot Clinic:
Step into the shoes of a doctor and podiatrist as you indulge in the foot clinic experience. Scrub, scrape, pluck, and pull all kinds of feet.

Perform foot treatments for conditions like calluses, corns and ingrown toenails. Each patient presents a new problem, so you'll never get bored of your work!

When you're ready to take a break, head to the on-site nail salon for a pampering session. Give someone's feet the attention they deserve with a various of nail polishes, tattoos and foot mask.

Features:
- 12 different tools for treating and beautifying feet
- mechanics of squeezing pimples, cutting nails, cleaning, shaving and much more
- lots of patients with various foot problems
- testing and vaccinating sick clients
- available tool skins to make the game even more funny
- equipment, furniture and decoration upgrades
Eden Coil:
A snake puzzle game where, on some levels, you control multiple snakes by switching between them while the others remain asleep.
\n
\nA top-down puzzle game where you guide a snake through carefully crafted levels, collecting apples and finding the way forward.
\n
\nAs the game unfolds, new rules come into play. Some levels feature multiple snakes, and you can switch between them — only one moves at a time while the others remain asleep. Their positions become part of the puzzle, letting you block paths, set up moves, and solve challenges that require more than a straightforward route.
Hyperdrive inn:
The ever-growing accommodation behemoth known as Hyperdrive Inn is your father’s creation, and he is also responsible for triggering a set of cataclysmic events that threaten to destroy everything in existence.

He also happens to be the only person in the universe who can fix everything. Too bad he has gone missing. What’s even worse: he went hiding somewhere in the infinite hotel of his. And to top it all off, you’re the one who must hunt him down and save the day.

The infinite hotel of Hyperdrive Inn is filled with weird visitors (and inhabitants), outlandish environments and brain-twisting puzzles. You’ll never know what you find, who you meet and where you end up.

Hyperdrive Inn is full of surprises, and who says you can’t have fun while the world is coming to an end? After all, there are only two things that are infinite: the hotel and human stupidity.

Features:
-Classic 2D point & click adventure with a modern touch
-Graphics made entirely from scanned fabric samples
-Fully original score with Finnish folk music influences
-Replay value through randomized content

Ironforged:
Earn Your Victory
There are no power fantasies here, no hand-holding. You fight with a minimal arsenal. Line up your shots, conserve ammo, control your breathing, and adapt under pressure. Every encounter tests your composure. 

Deep beneath a collapsing world, a hidden facility manufactures and tests mechanized soldiers.
You are CM-42. Endure and survive all 12 unique realms of the facility and earn deployment, or fail, and be melted down like all the failures before you.

Time Warp
Use Time Warp to slow the battlefield and strike with precision.

Takedown
Out of bullets? Take enemies down physically to regain the upper hand.

Mag Handling
Manually eject rounds and reorganize your magazines.

Upgrades
Upgrade to unlock new skills, then upgrade each individually.
Leafy Corner:
Run the plant shop of your dreams in Leafy Corner, a cozy shop management game where you grow, sell, and care for real-life houseplants!

Step into the role of a plant shop owner. Grow plants, serve your customers, and create a warm, inviting space filled with greenery and charm.

Watch your plants grow over time, unfolding leaf by leaf as you care for them.

Not everyone knows what they’re looking for. Sometimes customers bring unusual or tricky requests. Finding just the right plant to fit their needs adds a fun challenge.

Decorate your shop with a variety of unlockable items, from shelves to plant pots. Pick colors that fit your mood and create a space that reflects your unique style.

KEY FEATURES
- Grow, care for, and sell 100+ unique plants.
- Discover plant variegations.
- Build and decorate your shop with a variety of pots, furniture, and decoration options.
- Fulfill orders and help customers.
- Complete tasks to progress your shop.
- Increase your shop’s reputation to unlock new content.
- Customize your character.

What Leafy Corner does NOT offer:
- Hardcore management (deep economy, hiring staff).
- Advanced plant care.
- Storyline.
Mate'Morphosis:
Strategize and conquer in a brainteasing twist on a tabletop gaming classic! Mate’Morphosis is a chess-inspired puzzle game built around the concept of becoming the pieces that you capture. Outsmart each board, adapt to evolving mechanics and hunt down the rival king across every stage! Instead of commanding multiple pieces, you’ll need to navigate the board with a single player piece that transforms into the type of piece you’ve just defeated.

Step up from pawn to knight, bishop or rook in order to take out the queen and finally gain the freedom of movement necessary to checkmate the king. Your route evolves with every move. Learn as you go, even if you’re not a master at classic chess! Enjoy retro 2D pixel art presentation and tight hand-crafted challenges with quick restarts, fast strategic pacing and a gradual climb in difficulty across dozens of unique stages!

• Push your strategic thinking to the limit!
• Master 60 hand-crafted puzzles inspired by chess.
• Command a single piece and morph into the ones you defeat!
• Determine your route to victory over the queen and put the king in checkmate.
• Enjoy beginner-friendly rules and gradual increase in challenge!

This product entitles you to download both the digital PS4® version and the digital PS5® version of this game.
Ashigaru: The Last Shogun:
During the tumultuous Sengoku period, powerful Daimyos clashed in a relentless struggle for power and the conquest of the imperial capital.

Shingen of the Takeda clan and Ieyasu of the Tokugawa clan fought bloody battles to expand their territories and influence.

The great Shingen achieved numerous victories against his enemies but was grievously wounded in combat by Ieyasu’s forces.

Foreseeing the imminent death of their revered leader, the Takeda clan secretly dispatched their best Ashigaru warriors to annihilate Ieyasu’s forces and the entire Tokugawa clan.

This was their act of vengeance for the death of the legendary warlord, Shingen Takeda.
Feudal Baron: King's Land:
In Feudal Baron: King’s Land, you play as the ruler of a medieval barony. You start with just a few followers in their leaky tents. Are you a leader shrewd enough to turn your lands into a bustling city?

In this strategic city builder, you’ll get to live in the middle ages, constructing buildings, producing and delivering resources, and fighting off raiders until you’re strong enough to challenge the king himself.


Not on bread alone…
Your subjects need much more than food. Build taverns, churches, schools and graveyards. Cure plagues, extinguish fires, snuff out rebellions. Gather goods – from firewood and shoes to fine robes, stained glass windows and siege machine ammunition.

It’s the economy, my liege!
Trade with your neighbours and use a novel building range system to connect fields, mines, workshops, granaries and marketplaces into a fine-tuned mechanism to meet the needs of even the most finicky residents.


Politics and war
You have plenty of decrees to proclaim. Use them to celebrate feasts and make your subjects happy – or to drown rebellions in blood.

When raiders approach your town, lead your men and outwit your enemies to break the siege in the battle mode.

Play the way you like
Learn the story of the ambitious baron fighting for his lost birthright in a story-driven campaign. And when you like, try yourself against the unusual conditions of several independent scenarios or build a medieval city of your dreams in the free game mode.


Easy to learn, hard to master
No need for endless tutorials and instruction manuals here. In Feudal Baron: King’s Land, the campaign introduces you to the duties of a feudal lord in a manner that is both approachable and fun, until ruling your barony becomes second nature to you – and your city becomes your home, built with your own hands (or more precisely, with the hands of your subjects).
Looking for Fael:
A surreal, closed-door maze

It all starts with a strange voice message left by Fael, your roommate. Little by little, the apartment you thought you knew multiplies into a multifaceted maze filled with mysterious puzzles.

In search of a sign of life from your roommate, you'll have to learn to find your bearings in this enclosed space with its strange and lonely atmosphere. Advance room by room, decipher the clues left behind, and embark on the adventure that has transformed your apartment into a surreal maze.

But be careful: as you progress through this maze, you will be led to question the very nature of reality. Will you be able to connect the clues and piece together the puzzle left behind by Fael?

An immersive and nostalgic escape game

To find Fael, your wits will be your only ally. Each apartment is a puzzle in its own right, with its own logic behind a multitude of puzzles. But don't expect to find a comfort zone: the messages left by your roommate have been designed to confuse you...

However, this maze has a common thread that connects each apartment to the others: your actions in one place can have repercussions elsewhere, sometimes with unexpected consequences. All kinds of machines, created by Fael's genius, will be at your disposal to help you progress, such as the Game Leaf, a strange game console that is essential to your progress.

Activate mysterious mechanisms and impact your environment to solve puzzles and continue your exploration. From a simple living room to a room overgrown with vegetation, a cinema, a laboratory, and many other rooms, everything is connected, everything is one.

GAME FEATURES:
A kaleidoscope of apartments and atmospheres. 
Explore a variety of environments from the imagination of comic book author Benoît “Beloup” Leloup. From one apartment to another, discover a world full of cultural references and colors, reflecting Fael's dreamy personality.

The Game Leaf: a tribute to the 90s. 
Use your Game Leaf, a mysterious console straight out of the 90s. Solve puzzles in the form of nostalgic mini-games and unlock new areas to explore. Each apartment is a piece of the puzzle that will lead you to the truth about Fael's disappearance.

A cabinet of curiosities. 
The apartments are filled with oddities that will challenge your imagination and logic. Manipulate strange machines, let your natural curiosity run wild, experiment with solutions, and observe the fruits of your efforts.
The Crimson Maid:
The Crimson Maid is a narrative adventure that blends first-person exploration, visual novel storytelling, and light puzzle solving. Immerse yourself in a period drama that intertwines romance with murder mystery.

Step into the shoes of Marius, as he reconnects with his fractured family and becomes captivated by Irina, a beautiful young maid who has already unsettled the household.  Unravel the secrets of the family’s troubled past and through your choices, determine Marius’ ultimate fate. 

•	A compelling tale of romance, mystery and murder. 
•	Explore a beautiful noble estate and surrounding grounds. 
•	Meet complex characters with hidden motives. 
•	Discover secrets through exploration and investigation. 
•	Solve light puzzles and uncover forgotten truths. 
•	Your choices determine Marius’ ultimate fate.
Teeto:
ABSORB AND CHANGE FORMS
Teeto’s got a talent for absorbing all sorts of objects - and turning them into wild new forms! With Nory’s Vionite-powered backpack, they unlock unique abilities to outsmart enemies, solve puzzles, and discover hidden secrets. Mix it up, get creative, and see what strange new powers you’ll unleash!

TEAM UP TOGETHER
Life’s better with a buddy - and so is saving the world! Grab a friend and dive into split-screen co-op, where you’ll absorb, transform, and explore together. Solve puzzles, help each other out, and take on this wild adventure side by side!

CHAOS CORRUPTION
Chaos is spreading, and the shadow creatures are behind it! Teeto and Nory must team up, using their unique powers to stop the mayhem, restore balance, and keep the world from tipping into complete disorder!

MISSING MICHAELS
It started with one Michael - Nory’s first experiment. But Michael couldn’t stay simple… he split into two, then four, then eight! Now there are too many Michaels for anyone to handle. Track them down, rescue them, and bring the tiny mischief-makers home!

LEND A HAND, GET A HAND
Teeto and Nory aren’t the only ones in need of help. Along the way, you’ll meet a colourful cast of quirky characters, each with their own oddball dilemmas. Lend them a hand, and they might just return the favour with useful items, hidden secrets, or unexpected abilities.

DRESS THE PART
Teeto can unlock a variety of fun and stylish costumes, from the effortlessly cool to the absolutely ridiculous. Saving the world is important - but who says you can’t look fashionable while doing it?
Dungeon Antiqua:
Dungeon Antiqua is a dungeon crawl-type RPG with beautiful dots and nostalgic sounding chiptunes that are reminiscent of the 1980s and 1990s.

- 2D maps that expand to match the character's field of view.

- Fast-paced, modern and comfortable controls.

Dungeon Antiqua is a portal to new adventures for players who love retro games. Enjoy new challenges while reminiscing about the good old days of gaming!

Streetdog BMX:
Streetdog BMX is an action sports game where you ride through expansive maps sending extreme tricks, getting technical on the rails, and feeling the flow.

Customize your bike and rider before hitting the streets to explore six maps packed with wallrides, gaps, bowls, ramps and rails. Uncover new spots, complete handcrafted challenges, and link up your combos!


Your Bike, Your Rules

Focus on high scores and big air, or flow through levels at your own pace. Streetdog BMX accommodates all kinds of riders and play styles. Your lines can be as complex or as simple as you want them to be. Just keep in mind, the bigger the combo... the harder you fall.


Own the Streets

Unleash your creativity. Fakie, manual, icepick or wallride your way through over 270 sick challenges. From barspin to backflip, to crooked grind to crankflip - you’ll have a huge selection of tricks and stunts to use when you send it.


Customization Galore

With dozens of color and outfit options, you can customize your bike and rider the way you want. Play around with options for clothes, shoes, hair, tattoos and more. Build the BMX bike of your dreams with plenty of customizable options ranging from the frame down to the chainring.


BMX for Life

As a longtime BMX rider, I've been pouring my passion for the sport into games like Trail Boss BMX and the Pumped BMX series for years. Streetdog BMX is the action sports game I've always wanted to make and is the next step in combining my love of making games and getting on the bike.
Dark Town Secrets: Lost Lulu Collector’s:
A desperate plea from Lady Margaret tells of the sudden disappearance of her beloved dog, Lulu. 
\nAt first, it seems like a simple matter of a missing pet. 
\nBut as Casey arrives at the imposing mansion, it becomes clear this is no ordinary investigation. 
\nLulu’s past is shrouded in shadows, and Lady Margaret may not be telling the whole truth.
\n
\nSearch for clues in lavish yet haunting locations — from candlelit halls and dusty libraries to forgotten gardens and crypts cloaked in mystery. 
\nFeaturing beautiful artwork, atmospheric music, and a twisted storyline, 
\nDark Town Secrets: Lost Lulu delivers the timeless charm of classic hidden object gameplay alongside a variety of challenging puzzles that will test both logic and attentiveness.
\n
\nWill you be able to save Lulu — and the other dogs — before it’s too late? 
\nOr will the secrets of Dark Town remain forever buried?

Papercraft Tactics:
Papercraft Tactics is a run‑based, grid‑inventory roguelike with semi‑auto, turn‑based combat. You don’t just equip items—you wire them. Put swords next to potions, feed power from wands into shields, and rotate gear so inputs meet outputs. When a turn starts, your backpack comes alive: links fire, effects cascade, and enemies learn to fear tidy layouts.

Between rounds, draft new items, shop, and re‑arrange for ever‑bigger chains. During fights, play a handful of clutch cards to tweak the queue—double a hit, purge a debuff, or force a trigger now. The joy is in the planning: make a build that plays itself, then nudge it at the perfect moment.

All of this unfolds in a warm paper‑theater aesthetic—cut‑out characters, stage‑flat scenery, and a subtle handmade vibe.


The Core Loop
Loot & Draft new items with distinct inputs/outputs and tags (elemental, heavy, fragile, scaling, mimic).

Arrange items on a grid; rotate to align green inputs and yellow outputs; place for adjacency bonuses.

Battle (auto‑resolve, turn‑based): At turn start, linked items trigger in order, adding Actions to the queue (Attack, MagicCast, Recover, Block, InflictEffect, Special).

Play Cards to manipulate the queue (duplicate, remove, reset exhausted, trigger now) or inflict effects.

Progress through events, shops, and escalating encounters; refine the build; beat the boss; try a new hero.

Heroes, Stats & Resistances
Pick from distinct heroes with unique passives and stat profiles. Core stats include HP, SP, MP, STR, DEF, MND, SPR, Evade. Resistances cover physical types (Slash, Thrust, Strike, Projectile, Spell) and elements (Fire, Ice, Wind, Thunder, True). Synergies are predictable and readable—builds reward planning, not twitch.


Key Features
Living Backpack: Your grid inventory is the build. Rotate, link, and position to forge synergies.

Chain‑Reaction Combat: On OnPlayerTurnStart, items trigger and fill the action queue—combos you designed go off automatically.

Tactical Card Play: Limited‑use cards let you push the queue—DuplicateNextAction, ClearAttacks, ResetExhaustedCards, and more.

Readable Triggers: Clear events like OnSlashHit, OnReceiveFireDamage, OnEvade power effects without hidden rules.

Scaling & Mimic Items: Effects that grow from HP/MP/SP or copy linked behavior to extend chains.

Run‑Based Variety: Shops, events, elites, and bosses with different resist profiles make placement matter.

Paper‑Theater Style: Hand‑drawn lines, cut‑out layers, and cozy stage lighting.

No Dead Turns: Even defense builds feel active via blocks, conversions, and smart queue tweaks.

Learnable Depth: Simple pieces, deep compositions—like building a Rube Goldberg machine that fights back.

Cute Animals:
Cute Animals is a joyful collection of 12 educational mini-games designed especially for toddlers and preschoolers. Through colorful, hand-drawn worlds filled with charming animal characters, children develop essential early learning skills — all through play.

Apidya' Special:
APIDYA - A very special retro shoot 'em up buzzes into view!
\nTake flight in Apidya' Special, brought back through sheer Pixel Passion!
\n

\nFeatures:

Arcadia: Find the Difference 3D:
Arcadia: Find the Difference 3D is a 3D spot-the-difference game that invites you to slow down, explore, and enjoy beautifully crafted, fully rotatable scenes. Each level presents a detailed 360° 3D environment where you search for five hidden differences. Some are easy to notice, while others reward patience, curiosity, and careful observation.

The game also includes special levels where players solve mystery puzzles or complete mini-games, adding variety beyond the classic spot-the-difference experience.

Arcadia is designed to be relaxing rather than stressful. There are no timers pushing you forward and no punishment for failing a level. Instead, the game encourages you to take your time, rotate each scene, and enjoy the details from every angle.

Key Features
Artistic and Visual Experience

Every part of Arcadia is created with a strong focus on art and atmosphere. From handcrafted 3D models and detailed environments to a clean user interface and calm background music, the game aims to create a visually pleasing and comfortable space for players to explore.

Explore in Full 360 Degrees

Freely rotate each scene and examine it from any direction. Some differences can only be discovered by changing your viewpoint, making exploration an important part of the experience.

Local Co-op and Online Play

Arcadia supports both local co-op and online multiplayer. Normal levels can be played in local co-op by enabling the option in the settings, making it easy to enjoy the game together on the same device.

The game also includes a real-time online mode where up to 15 players can compete together, adding a fun and social way to experience the world of Arcadia.

Varied and Interactive Gameplay

In addition to classic spot-the-difference challenges, Arcadia includes more than ten mini-games. Some differences also involve simple puzzle interactions, adding variety and a sense of discovery to each level.

Expansive Worlds to Discover

Arcadia currently features over 50 uniquely themed scenes, each with its own mood and visual style. More scenes and mini-games are planned for future updates, expanding the world over time.

Progression and Collectibles

By completing levels, players earn stars that can be used in an in-game building system. These stars allow you to unlock and place beautiful furniture to decorate your room.

Hidden Easter eggs throughout the game can also unlock exclusive 3D figurines, encouraging players to explore carefully and enjoy the experience beyond simply finding differences.

Accessibility and Inclusive Design

Arcadia is designed so visual differences are never based on color alone. Differences can be identified through shape, lighting, texture, or placement. A colorblind-friendly mode improves contrast and visual clarity, helping make the game more comfortable for players with color vision differences.

BrokenLore: DON'T LIE:
BrokenLore: DON'T LIE is a Japanese psychological horror game exploring trauma, isolation, and a fractured reality where perception becomes increasingly unreliable. 

Step into the life of Junko, a hikikomori whose carefully controlled world begins to unravel as the past resurfaces in ways she can no longer ignore. 

Raised by a father who was always present but never truly there, Junko learned early to retreat inward. When her few attempts at connection were met with rejection and humiliation, she shut herself away from the outside world. 

As the boundaries between memory and reality begin to fracture, familiar places transform into reflections of her past. Through exploration, unsettling encounters, and the gradual unravelling of Junko's story, she must confront the people, experiences, and emotions she has spent years trying to escape before she loses herself completely. 

Features

Japanese First-person psychological horror: Explore, investigate, and survive within a grounded, slow-burn descent into paranoia and perception.  

Confined exploration:  Search Junko’s apartment and surrounding distorted spaces through messages, files, and environmental clues to uncover hidden truths.  

Tension:  Stay out of sight and move carefully as an unseen presence begins to track your behaviour.   

Fractured reality:  Shift between familiar environments and warped liminal spaces shaped by Junko’s memories, where her memories and fears manifest.  

BrokenLore Series: DON'T LIE is part of the “BrokenLore” series of games that can be played and enjoyed as a standalone story.  

Wired Productions: Produced by psychological narrative specialists, WP, adding additional layers of narrative and depth, for a richer experience.
Future Knight:
Future Knight is a 2D action Shoot 'Em Up that fuses the nostalgia of LCD screens with the brutality of modern combat. Imagine your old handheld console coming to life, but with a bizarre story, frantic combat, and a unique visual aesthetic inspired by classic electronic handheld games.
\n
\n8 HOURS TO THE END OF THE WORLD
\nIt is May 23rd, 1993. The Lady of the Past, leader of the "Present" pyramid scheme cult, has just washed her underwear and, incidentally, wiped the brains of all humanity. Only you, a robot built over 30 years from the remains of a 90s soap opera actor, can stop her. But you are not alone. You have Two More, a benign tumor—inexplicably powerful and with a life of its own—living inside you.
\n
\nYour mission is to travel to the past, exactly 8 hours before the apocalypse. Each level (Biome) represents one hour in this lady's schedule before she wipes our memories. You will have to sabotage her day: from her walk in the park to her meal at an all-you-can-eat buffet... The clock is ticking, Future Knight. Can you save the future before it becomes the past?
\n
\nTHE LETHAL DANCE: SWITCH AND DESTROY
\nThe key to Future Knight is Synergy. "Alone you go fast, together you go further."
\n
\nFuture Knight (The Muscle): Fire your quantum plasma Techno Blaster, deliver lethal bites, roll to dodge, and unleash chaos with heavy weaponry.
\n
\nTwo More (The Agility): Eject your partner! Use him to perform lethal Super Dashes, climb walls with his natural viscosity, fire at short range, and squeeze into tight spots.
\n
\nChoreography of Violence: Switch between both characters instantly. Recover Future Knight's health by using Two More, and recharge Two More's energy by using Future Knight. Create a deadly dance to annihilate your enemies with style.
\n
\nBIZARRE "NEO-RETRO" AESTHETIC
\nThe game takes place inside the technology of a calculator and a liquid crystal display. We have created an unsettling aesthetic that blends the adorable with the grotesque, inspired by the works of Satoshi Kon and Japanese weirdness. Everything you see is ink blots moving... but we assure you, you've never seen ink move like this.
\n
\nKEY FEATURES
\nA Race Against Time: 8 hours, 8 biomes, one destination. Beat levels that alternate between horizontal and vertical scrolling with crazy physics. From dangerous construction sites to deadly sushi conveyor belts, every level is a critical hour before the mass memory wipe.
\n
\nCombat Synergy: Shooting isn't enough; you have to dance. Instantly switch between Future Knight's brute force and Two More's slimy agility to create lethal choreographies. Master their differences and collect the mysterious sectarian triangles, the only key capable of unlocking the path to the truth.
\n
\n"Liquid Crystal" Pixel Art: A unique art direction where LCD nostalgia comes to life. Fluid, hand-drawn animations that look like ink blots, fusing the cute with the grotesque in a visual homage to the handheld electronic games of the 80s.
\n
\nBizarre and Unfiltered Narrative: A story that is "less pretentious and much more fun." Face pyramid scheme cults and surreal situations in a plot full of dark humor and social satire.
\n
\nUnforgettable Final Bosses: Test your reflexes against bosses born from an insane mind, designed to offer epic, challenging fights full of surprises.
Hazard Pay:
The job is simple: destroy evidence. Leave no trace. Don’t die in the process. 
Hazard Pay is a pixel-art block-pushing puzzler set in a crumbling dystopian world. You’ll navigate alone through abandoned and contaminated facilities, dodging environmental hazards while completing your employer’s checklist with calculated efficiency.
Pack up the truck and head to the site. Mop the floors. Remove the evidence. Destroy the ███████. Do not leave anything behind, not even your footsteps. There’s blood on the floor and smoke in the air. Relax. It’s just another accident to clean up. Do the job properly and no one has to get in trouble. 
Each site is a compact, intricate puzzle with moving parts. You can use the environment to gather scattered documents or push ███████ into chemical barrels to erase any wrongdoing. One wrong move, and you could be trapped, dissolved in acid, or worse. Plan ahead. Improvise when you must. Stay sharp. Global Leaderboards.
Even after a job’s done, you can always go back. Every move is tracked, and your final step count determines your rank. Pull off a perfect run, and your name might just show up on the global leaderboard. Compare your stats with friends or the world. Just remember, your employer is always watching.
All you know is the name: IPT. No faces, no meetings. Just a radio, and they talk first. You can feel something’s off. But are you really ready to dig into it? Some things are better left buried. Will you stay obedient… or resist? Features Ingenious, compact, handcrafted puzzle levels. Grid-based push/pull mechanics with environmental twists. Global and friends leaderboards. Dystopian narrative told through the environment. Detailed pixel art and matching atmosphere.
