Fractured Worlds:
Fractured Worlds is a Dark Fantasy Action RPG set in a reality that has been broken into pieces by the ambition of its inhabitants. Now, guided by a mysterious voice, you must explore these broken realms, piece together the past, and confront those responsible for this cataclysmic event.

Deliberate, Precision-Based Combat
Each weapon has its own weight, speed and moveset. From two handed maces with slow staggering attacks, to nimble spears perfect for crowd controlling enemies and magic wands controlling the flow of Aether - everything plays and feels different. The classless progression system allows for multiple respecs so it’s easy to try a little bit of everything or adjust your character to a particularly powerful Legendary item you find.

Encounter Other Players
Reality's distortion means that the worlds of other players might briefly overlap with yours. You can choose to interact with them, or simply continue on your own path. You can invade and assist, support and deceive, share a profitable loot pile or lure other players into a particularly deadly mob of enemies and collect the spoils once they are dealt with.

Explore Diverse, Broken Realms 
Journey through unique procedural environments that are fragments of former worlds. Navigate medieval Dungeons, the mystical enchanted Forests, volcanic landscapes, and future industrial Cities. Find memory fragments that reveal the stories of those affected by the cataclysm, helping you understand what happened and mend the broken world.

Share a Piece of Your World
Map Shards are powerful artifacts that allow players to share a piece of their world with others. Map Shards create a co-operative instance with random modifiers that unpredictably alters the monsters that inhabit the area and boost the loot they are guarding. When sharing the area with others, players can comment on it letting everyone know about what to expect in the area: vast riches or especially challenging encounters.

Face Challenging Bosses 
Confront powerful bosses that stand in your way. Battle the Treasure Golem, the mind-altering Rorsch, the imposing Ghostly Knight, and many more. Each boss encounter is a tough and deadly challenge where a single mistake can cost you a significant chunk of your health if played poorly. But every action in these fights is thoughtfully designed and well-telegraphed, so with practice, you can conquer even the greatest foe.

Fractured Worlds offers a journey through a broken reality, focusing on direct action and the task of restoring what was lost.

Stronger Together

Playgrounds

Home Sweet Home
The park is yours to claim. Build everything from simple shelters to sprawling fortresses that keep you safe from the dangers outside. But don't limit yourself to just dry land. Live the double life of a resourceful merchant and fearless adventurer in this sequel to the hit rogue-lite Action-RPG! Stranded without a coin in the village of Tresna, Will must open shop again as he dives into an interdimensional adventure. Explore dangerous dungeons, loot ancient relics, sell them, and reinvest in the town's prosperity. The magical, addictive loop returns—bigger, bolder, and packed with shiny loot.

FORTUNE FAVORS THE BOLD 
Profitable perils await as dimensional exploration evolves. Strap on your trusty backpack and master dynamic combat with various weapon classes, armor sets, and powerful perks. Chart a path through unpredictable worlds, defeat relentless foes and formidable bosses, then carefully arrange your loot to unlock unique item synergies. Managing your backpack is key to financial success and maximizing profits. The deeper you go, the greater the rewards—and the risks.

MONEY NEVER SLEEPS 
After every adventure, it's time to open for business. Customize your shop, set your prices, and read your customers to strike the perfect deal. Unlock sales perks, capitalize on special events, and optimize your displays to maximize profits. From battered scrap to priceless relics, every item's value is yours to decide.

THE ENDLESS VAULT 
Take on the Endless Vault, a mysterious ancient artifact that pushes your skills to the limit. Overcome its ever-growing challenges to upgrade your town and earn increasingly valuable rewards. Will it be enough to reclaim your homeland from the evil Moloch, an interdimensional collector who has claimed your beloved village for himself?

A NEW DIMENSION OF ADVENTURE
Dive into Moonlighter’s stunning visual leap into 3D. Explore vibrant environments, enjoy smoother, more dynamic combat, and experience the iconic cycle of daytime shopkeeping and nighttime treasure hunting like never before.

Project Neon:
In the desolate future of 2042, Earth teeters on the brink of ecological collapse due to relentless climate change. The only hope lies with a visionary who abandoned Earth to start anew on Mars, disgusted by humanity’s negativity and the financial betrayal of his ventures.

“Project Neon” is your top-secret mission to navigate the treacherous cosmos and bring this recluse back from his Martian stronghold, without harming him, to salvage our dying planet. He has fortified Mars with an impenetrable shield, anchored by defenses on four neighboring planets.

Each planet is guarded by fierce enemies and daunting bosses, integral to maintaining the shield. Your task: dismantle this interplanetary defense, planet by planet, in a high-stakes shoot ’em up adventure.

Are you ready to face the ultimate shmup challenge and save Earth?

Tailbreak:
A new dinosaur-blasting adventure is in town!

Serving as a follow-up to Railbreak and as a retelling of the hit DINOBREAK, Tailbreak evolves the arcade on-rails shooter experience from mere resurrection to pleasingly primal for up to two players!

Weapons and mechanics have been intensified; starting with just a handgun, you’ll need to make tough choices about your sub-weapons and juggle pick-ups with the new item system.  Do you dedicate an item slot to a grenade or a healing item?  Do you stick with your trusty machine gun, or do you switch it up with a heavy rifle?  

With new and realistic lighting utilizing Unreal Engine 5.7, Cypress Ridge looks more sinister and desolate than ever before.  A new, fully-voiced, six-act Story mode tells the plight of heroines Alex and Rin as they struggle to survive the events of DINOBREAK without becoming dino food.  The Arrange mode brings custom handguns and upgradable sub-weapons to the fray for something a little zanier, while the Mutation Matrix randomizes the game’s encounters and items for an unpredictable experience every play-through!

More bonus modes and features await as you take on nature’s ancient beasts on the safari of a lifetime in Tailbreak! Even better, you can invite the undead to the party in all bonus modes with the choice of facing dinosaurs, zombies, or a mix of the two!

Features:

NEW Item System:  Pick up healing items, ammo, and more, but be careful: you can only hold two at a time!  Will you prioritize the extra firepower of a grenade, or will you hold onto a precious, life-restoring sprout for a rainy day?

Fierce Firepower:  Blast away with both returning and new weapons.  Carefully manage your sub-weapon ammo, or you may find yourself up dino creek without a paddle!  In Arrange mode, choose between handguns with different effects, and level up your sub-weapons to make them more powerful.

Deliciously Cheesy:  Enjoy a new story where lead characters Alex and Rin check out the coolest new game in Cypress Ridge Arcade – Tailbreak! It’s all about their search for safety in a city ravaged by raptors.  All six acts feature full voice acting with hysterical banter and the crazy camp you’d expect in your favorite B-movie!

Gameplay Galore:  Bonus modes like Score Attack, Arrange Mode, and Mutation Matrix add additional depth and extra replayability to the game.  Plus, all content can be experienced solo or in local co-op play with a friend! And don't forget, outside of the Story Mode experience you can choose to face the ruthless dinosaurs, terrifying zombies, or a mixture of the two!

Scarily Beautiful:  The world of Cypress Ridge comes to life whether you’re blasting through a restaurant or sulking through dark caverns thanks to the power of cutting-edge Unreal Engine 5.7, which brings stunning ray traced lighting to the varied, highly-detailed environments you’ll flee through during your exploits.

Nightmare Delivery:
Nightmare Delivery is a cooperative psychological horror game where players take the role of couriers sent into places no delivery should ever reach.

You do not deliver to houses, streets, or real locations.
You enter the distorted consciousness of different people and carry a package meant for the darkness hidden inside them.

Each mission takes place inside a strange mental space shaped by fear, memory, guilt, obsession, or trauma. These places may look familiar at first, but their logic is broken. Corridors lead where they should not, rooms repeat without reason, and ordinary objects can become part of the puzzle.

Play alone or in online co-op with up to 4 players. Explore unsettling locations, solve environmental puzzles, avoid dangerous entities, and work together to reach the final delivery point.

The goal is not only to escape.
The goal is to find what is hiding inside the mind, deliver the package, and survive long enough to return.

Every level has its own atmosphere, rules, puzzles, and threats. Some creatures can be avoided. Others must be understood. Running is not always enough — sometimes survival depends on learning how the nightmare behaves.

Complete the delivery.
Calm the darkness.
Get out alive.
